records.claim: Valproic acid can lower folic acid levels in the body. Taking 400 mcg of folic acid daily before and during early pregnancy can help prevent NTDs. Studies have not shown that higher doses of folic acid reduce NTD risk for women taking valproic acid. If you are taking valproic acid, talk with your healthcare provider about what dose of folic acid is right for you. For more information on folic acid, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet at: https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/folic-acid/.
